description: This file defines a CMake function named `compile_aidl` used to generate source code from AIDL files during build time. It contains helper code to locate the `aidl` compiler, set options, include directories, and execute the compilation process, facilitating the integration of AIDL-based code generation into the build system.

methods.name: compile_aidl
methods.description: A CMake function that automates the source code generation from AIDL files during build, allowing configuration of the aidl compiler path, language, include directories, and output target.
